hotels.title: Budget-Friendly Sydney Airport Stay for Easy Pre-Flight Convenience
hotels.description: Set moments from Sydney Airport, this polished stay places Mascot’s cafés, craft breweries and international eateries within easy reach, with the CBD only a short train ride away. Nearby Alexandria tempts with artisan coffee at The Grounds, design-led boutiques and the acclaimed French fare of Bistro St Jacques. Compact, contemporary rooms are designed for streamlined comfort, with private ensuites, air conditioning and Wi-Fi. Before an early flight or after a late arrival, guests can pick up breakfast onsite or head to Mascot’s Bourke Street Bakery for flaky pastries and expertly brewed coffee
